title: FR: ISF (Insulin Sensitivity Factor) intermediate/low values
body:
For example (in prediction simulator settings):
ISF 1 and 0.9 difference is 10%.
But ISF 0.1 and 0.2 difference is 50%.
So, at lower values difference is​​ getting bigger.

I need "intermediate" value(s) for ISF (I'm interested in 0.35).

Thanks.
